name: Ammonia synthesis converter
description: Catalytic reactor in the Haber-Bosch loop where hydrogen and nitrogen combine over an iron catalyst to form ammonia. Conversion per pass is limited by equilibrium, so the loop circulates unreacted gas, condenses ammonia by refrigeration and returns the remainder to the converter. Primary source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ammonia_production
applications: ammonia synthesis in nitrogen fertiliser and chemical plants
green and blue ammonia plants using electrolytic or low-carbon hydrogen
